premise: A young dancer working at a rural highway strip club and truck stop gets pulled into a vicious power struggle with an older, hard-bitten dancer who takes her under her wing while manipulating her deeper into a narcotics-smuggling operation tied to the business. As the protagonist chases fast money to escape, she must decide whether to outplay her mentor, join her, or be consumed by the sleazy empire around them.
tone: Outrageous 1970s exploitation pulp; dark, sleazy, campy, and tense with a satirical edge
setting: A grimy rural highway truck stop and the strip club next door, both under the same ownership and management, evoking a lurid 1970s exploitation-movie America of neon, diesel, back rooms, and criminal deals
protagonist: A younger club dancer, ambitious and relatively inexperienced compared to the women around her. She wants to get rich fast so she can escape this dead-end world, but her hunger for money and status makes her vulnerable to manipulation and escalation.
core_hook: The protagonist enters a toxic mentorship with an older rival dancer while both women are entangled in narcotics smuggling run through the truck stop, turning ambition, jealousy, and survival into a volatile pulp thriller.
must_have_elements: A younger dancer protagonist at a strip club
An older dancer antagonist/rival with a 'been around the block' presence
A toxic mentorship between the two women
A power struggle within the club’s social and economic hierarchy
Criminal activity tied to the truck stop, specifically narcotics smuggling
A rural highway truck stop and adjacent strip club under the same ownership
A dialogue-driven structure suitable for a simple Ren'Py visual novel
Satirical elements woven into the thriller framework
concept_summary: Set in a grimy rural truck stop and its adjacent strip club, this dialogue-driven visual novel channels the outrageous energy of a 1970s exploitation thriller with a satirical bite. The player follows a young dancer who only wants to get rich enough to escape, but she becomes entangled with an older, more dangerous dancer whose toxic mentorship pulls her into a narcotics-smuggling scheme operating through the business. Their relationship is equal parts rivalry, dependence, and manipulation, with the club’s hierarchy becoming a battleground for money, control, and survival. The story should feel lurid, tense, campy, and unapologetically pulpy, with character-driven scenes carrying the momentum.
